overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs Reserve Edition 3-Person Full Spectrum PureTech™ Near Zero EMF FAR Infrared Sauna with Himalayan Salt Bar offers a luxurious and health-focused retreat in the comfort of your home. Designed for indoor use, this sauna combines the natural beauty of Canadian Hemlock wood with advanced technology, featuring 8 heaters, including 3 PureTech™ Near Zero EMF FAR IR Carbon Panels, to promote muscle relaxation, stress relief, and improved circulation. The integrated chromotherapy and red light therapy enhance your wellness experience, while the built-in FM station, Bluetooth, and MP3 connectivity provide entertainment. Ideal for basements, master baths, or fitness rooms, this sauna is a perfect addition to your wellness routine.
